actionConfiguration.body:
INSERT INTO documents (
    company_id,
    document_type,
    document_number,
    document_date,
    due_date,
    partner_id,
    warehouse_id,
    payment_method,
    currency_code,
    exchange_rate,
    subtotal_amount,
    discount_amount,
    tax_amount,
    total_amount,
    paid_amount,
    status,
    posting_status,
    sales_channel,
    note,
    created_by_user_id
)
VALUES (
    {{ Number(appsmith.store.companyId || 0) }},
    {{ InvoiceDocumentTypeSelect.selectedOptionValue || "SALES_INVOICE" }},
    {{ InvoiceNumberInput.text }},
    {{ moment(InvoiceDateInput.selectedDate || moment()).format("YYYY-MM-DD") }},
    {{ InvoiceDueDateInput.selectedDate ? moment(InvoiceDueDateInput.selectedDate).format("YYYY-MM-DD") : null }},
    {{ Number(InvoiceCustomerSelectForm.selectedOptionValue || 0) || null }},
    {{ Number(InvoiceWarehouseSelectForm.selectedOptionValue || 0) || null }},
    {{ InvoicePaymentMethodSelect.selectedOptionValue || "BANK" }},
    {{ InvoiceCurrencySelect.selectedOptionValue || "EUR" }},
    {{ Number(InvoiceExchangeRateInput.text || 1) }},
    {{ Number(this.params.totals?.subtotal || 0) }},
    {{ Number(this.params.totals?.discount || 0) }},
    {{ Number(this.params.totals?.tax || 0) }},
    {{ Number(this.params.totals?.total || 0) }},
    0,
    'DRAFT',
    'NOT_POSTED',
    {{ InvoiceSalesChannelSelect.selectedOptionValue || "BACKOFFICE" }},
    {{ InvoicePaymentMethodSelect.text || null }},
    {{ Number(appsmith.store.userId || 0) || null }}
);
